overview: Monaco is a tiny city-state on the Mediterranean coast, surrounded on land by France. It is the second-smallest country in the world, after Vatican City, and one of the most densely populated. Monaco is a principality ruled by the Grimaldi family, and it is famous for its casino in Monte Carlo and the Monaco Grand Prix.

geography.text: Monaco is squeezed onto a narrow, hilly strip of coast at the foot of the Alps, so its buildings are tall and packed closely together. Parts of the country have been built on land reclaimed from the sea. It has no farmland and no rivers or lakes of any size.
